attchmntText: BSL Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: BSL Limited has published its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in The Financial Express Delhi edition and Dainik Navjyoti Ajmer edition on 14th November 2026. The company has submitted the newspaper publication copies to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited for their records. The advertisement is also available on the company website at www.bslltd.com.

attchmntText: BSL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release of the company".
voiceSummary: BSL Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations increased by 6.0% year-on-year to Rs. 363 crore. EBITDA rose by 17.9% to Rs. 31 crore, with an EBITDA margin of 8.6%. Profit after tax grew 2.2 times to Rs. 5 crore. The company reported quarterly revenue of Rs. 193.3 crore for Q2 FY27. Managing Director Nivedan Churiwal cited improved operational efficiency and cost management. The announcement includes segmental performance data for yarn, fabric, and furnishing. BSL Limited operates vertically integrated spinning, weaving, and processing facilities. The press release is available on the company website.

attchmntText: BSL Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: BSL Limited filed an investors' presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Revenue from operations for H1 FY27 stood at 363.27 crore, showing 6.0% year-on-year growth. EBITDA increased by 17.9% to 31.08 crore with margins at 8.6%. Profit after tax rose 2.2 times to 4.84 crore. For Q2 FY27, revenue was 193.43 crore and PAT was 3.12 crore. The company highlighted a proposed renewable energy investment and focus on manufacturing efficiency. Total assets for H1 FY27 were 671.17 crore. Long-term borrowings stood at 170.39 crore. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: BSL Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Shri Varenya Churiwal and Ms. Anushka Mimani as Other of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: BSL Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 19331.56 lakh for the quarter and Rs. 36303.75 lakh for the half year. Profit after tax was Rs. 311.01 lakh for the quarter and Rs. 483.84 lakh for the half year. The Board appointed Shri Varenya Churiwal as Additional Director and Ms. Anushka Mimani as Additional Independent Director, effective 13th November 2026. These appointments are subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot. The trading window for directors and key managerial personnel opens on 16th November 2026.
